name: Spread
summary: Each stack doubles the bullets per pull (1, 2, 4, 8). They fan out. Still one round of ammo per pull.

name: Grow
summary: Adds a charge time before each shot. Bullets are twice as big and do 1.5x damage. Each stack: x2 size, x1.5 damage, x1.25 charge time.

name: Poison
summary: Hits poison the enemy: 3 damage/s for 4 s. Bullets do 20% less direct damage. Each stack doubles the damage/s.

name: Pierce
summary: Bullets pass through 2 enemies (so can hit 3). Each enemy passed takes 20% off the bullet's damage. Each stack passes through one more enemy.

name: Quickdraw
summary: Fire faster: each stack multiplies fire rate by 1.5. Does not shorten Grow's charge time.

name: Exploit
summary: +15% damage to everything and +75% to poisoned or chilled enemies. Each stack doubles the bonus.

name: Shrapnel
summary: Every hit explodes (radius 40) for 40% of the damage dealt. Each stack doubles blast damage and widens it 50%.

name: Chill
summary: Hits slow the enemy to 60% speed for 3 s. Each stack doubles the duration.

name: Bloodshot
summary: Fire 1 extra bullet for every 25 HP you have. Each stack halves the HP needed (25, 12, 6). Use 'Hurt me' to test.

name: Reclaimer
summary: Every 6th bullet fired refunds one round of ammo. Each stack halves the count (6, 3, 2 minimum).

name: Blast Ring
summary: Every 5th bullet explodes around you (radius 90) for 120% damage to enemies and 8 damage to you. Each stack halves the count (5, 3, 2) and doubles the blast damage.

name: Shockwave
summary: Every 4th bullet shoves all enemies within 160 away from you. Each stack halves the count (4, 2 minimum) and widens the shove 50%.

name: Echo
summary: Every 4th hit spawns one extra bullet in a random direction from the impact. It counts as fired and goes through your upgrades (each has a chance to apply). Limited to generation 2. Each stack halves the count (4, 2 minimum).

name: Zigzag
summary: Bullets weave side to side and cross the same enemy twice. On-hit effects trigger on each crossing. Each stack doubles the crossings per enemy (2, 4).

name: Ricochet
summary: Bullets bounce off walls and enemies and lose 15% damage per bounce. Each stack doubles the bounces (1, 2, 4).

name: Volatile Core
summary: Dead enemies explode in a fixed blast (radius 50) for 60% of their max HP. Each stack doubles the blast damage.

name: Soul Snatcher
summary: +5% damage when picked, then +0.1% damage for every enemy killed. Each stack adds +5% at pick and doubles the per-kill rate. Resets with 'Reset counters'.

name: Reaper
summary: Needs Soul Snatcher. +10 max HP when picked, then +0.1% max HP per kill (current HP rises with it). Capped at +150%. Each stack adds +10 and doubles the per-kill rate.

name: Gravity Seed
summary: Hits pull nearby enemies toward the impact for about 2 seconds so they pack together. Each stack doubles the pull time.

name: Shard Bloom
summary: Hits embed shards in the enemy. At 6 shards they all detonate together (50% of the bullet's damage per shard, radius 60). Each stack halves the shards needed (6, 3, 2).

name: Third Strike
summary: Hit an enemy twice within 3 seconds and it is stunned for 2 s. A third hit disintegrates it (bosses lose 20% max HP instead). Each stack doubles the window.

name: Bond Arc
summary: A hit links the enemy to the nearest others with a beam for 4 s. Damage and poison/chill are shared along the link. Each stack doubles the number linked (2, 4, 8).

name: Twin Gate
summary: The first two walls your bullets hit become a linked portal pair. Bullets and enemies that enter one come out of the other. Each stack doubles the pairs.

name: Still Field
summary: A hit creates a freezing zone (radius 70) for 2 s. Enemies inside are held still (your bullets are not affected). Each stack doubles the freeze time.

name: Brood Seed
summary: Each kill has a 30% chance to hatch a drone that chases and bites enemies and never expires (max 60 at once). Bites carry your on-hit effects. Each stack doubles the drones per proc.

name: Orbit Shard
summary: Every 5th bullet orbits you for 5 s as a shield that damages enemies on contact. Each stack halves the count (5, 3, 2 minimum).

name: Fault Line
summary: A bullet's path cracks the ground. After 1.5 s the crack erupts and damages everything on it (100% of the bullet's damage). Each stack doubles the eruption damage.

name: Heat Coil
summary: Each pull builds heat. At full heat (10 pulls) the next pull fires one huge piercing beam (5x damage) instead of bullets, then heat resets. Each stack halves the pulls (10, 5, 3).

name: Adaptive Round
summary: Bullets do bonus damage to the species you have hit most. +0.5% per hit on that species. Each stack doubles the gain per hit. Resets with 'Reset counters'.

name: Split
summary: When a bullet hits an enemy it fires another bullet in a random direction. Each stack adds one guaranteed split per hit. New bullets keep full base damage but each of their other upgrades only has a 50% chance to apply, halving again each generation. Chain stops at generation 3.
